service.enabled.description: Whether the health-check service is enabled. Controls inclusion of [Service] section and ExecStart.

options.pid.description: List of process IDs or process names to monitor. May be empty if monitoring by other means (e.g., user mode). Cannot be used with options.username. Values are joined with commas for -p option.

options.duration.description: Analysis duration in seconds. A value of 0 runs indefinitely until monitored process exits.

options.max_timeouts.description: Maximum number of timeout-blocking system calls logged before completing. Prevents overwhelming logging for very busy processes.

options.logfile.description: Path to output JSON formatted log file. If empty, no log file is written.

options.username.description: User to run health-check as. Cannot be used with -p. If empty, runs as root (default).

options.follow_forks.description: Follow fork, vfork, and clone system calls to track new child processes.

options.wakelock_deep.description: Enable deep wakelock monitoring using system call inspection (uses more CPU). Incompatible with brief mode.

options.wakelock_light.description: Enable lightweight wakelock monitoring via fnotify (fast, simple).

options.verbose.description: Enable verbose mode (currently only for -W). Incompatible with -b.

options.monitor_children.description: Find and monitor all child processes and threads (useful with -p to attach to running processes).
